original_rule: Cycle diagnostics are allowed only for explicitly supplied same geometric bands after a schema-only band crosswalk has been frozen and explained.
cause: The implementer interpreted supplied band labels plus derived guided box-center angle order as sufficient. Guided input did not independently declare a corresponding geometric sequence. This was an implementation scope error under the existing protocol, not a new stricter gate added after seeing results.
timeline: Protocol frozen by root before comparison.
Schema-only crosswalk froze the erroneous permission to derive guided center-angle order.
Full v1 output was frozen before reading its summary.
Root reminded the implementer of the existing supplied-sequence limitation.
v2 preserves every non-cycle field and marks all cycle comparisons uncomputed.
Root corrected the wording of the first addendum: this is enforcement of the original protocol, not a new policy requirement.
v1_status: Archived exploratory box-center geometric invariance only; excluded from protocol-compliant complete-sequence conclusions. Not an independently supplied guided sequence.
v2_status: Authoritative rectangle comparison; all cycle comparisons NOT_COMPUTED because independently declared guided geometric sequence is absent.
